title: Flightio · Travel in One Clear Flow
summary: Brand, campaign and product direction for an online travel agency built around clarity, movement and measurable action.
clientDescription: An online travel agency focused on digital booking for flights, trains and intercity travel.
challenge: Unify high-volume performance marketing, seasonal campaigns and product landing pages without losing a coherent brand signal.
role: Visual direction, campaign key visuals, hero imagery and landing-page design across brand, marketing and product.
deliverables: Product hero-image system, portal campaign key visuals, performance assets, environmental advertising and the Flightio Aurora landing page.
credits: Visual direction and design by Ali Komeili. Portfolio imagery was newly reconstructed at high resolution from original project references.

blocks.title: Travel, reduced to one clear decision.
blocks.text: Flightio operated where brand recognition, marketing performance and product clarity meet. The visual system turned movement into a consistent language—one that could sell a seat, launch a campaign and guide a user from intent to booking.

blocks.alt: A coordinated family of hero images for Flightio bus, train and flight products

blocks.title: One direction. A distinct hero for every product.
blocks.text: Flights, trains and intercity buses were given their own hero image inside one controlled visual family. Consistent horizons, scale, color and negative space made the product set feel ordered while preserving a clear point of difference for each service.

blocks.title: A portal between planning and experience.
blocks.text: Campaign imagery treated booking as the threshold to a different place. A luminous ring became the recurring device: clear enough for performance media, cinematic enough for brand campaigns, and flexible across Iran-focused travel stories.

blocks.alt: Iranian woman traveler approaching a luminous portal from Arg of Karim Khan in Shiraz to the Colosseum in Rome

blocks.title: The portal becomes the campaign frame.
blocks.text: The same circular threshold connected the hero artwork, performance formats and outdoor placements. In every execution, the traveler remains on the edge of departure while the destination opens directly in front of them.

blocks.alt: Flightio portal campaign on a large roadside billboard in Tehran with the Persian campaign layout

blocks.title: Aurora brings the campaign energy into the interface.
blocks.text: Flightio Aurora translated the halo into a focused product surface. Travel modes, route selection and reassurance cues were organized around one primary action, keeping the experience expressive without competing with the booking task.
